item.title: Champaign County Clerk urges voters to submit primary election ballots early following USPS postmark changes
item.description: Illinois Newsroom - Champaign County Clerk Aaron Ammons is urging voters to get their primary election ballots in ahead of time as changes to U.S. Postal Service transportation rules could affect when some mail-in ballots are postmarked. The clerk is also asking residents to consider serving as election judges. The post Champaign County Clerk urges voters to submit primary election ballots early following USPS postmark changes appeared first on IPM Newsroom.
